title: GroundedClinicalResponse
description: Response schema for the Day 3 Plan B notebook (GROUNDING_SYSTEM_PROMPT). Enforces the required JSON shape and structurally enforces Rule 4: any confidence other than 'insufficient' must be backed by real evidence and at least one citation.

recommendation.description: The answer, or a plain refusal when    confidence is 'insufficient'.

evidence.description: The supporting evidence text backing the recommendation. Empty string only when confidence is 'insufficient'.

citations.description: List of citations backing the recommendation. Empty only when confidence is 'insufficient'.

page.description: Page number the cited text appears on.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the answer. 'insufficient' is the escape hatch when context doesn't support a confident answer.
